name: project-maintenance
description: Assess existing local projects with evidence-backed, paged policy audits and apply approved, targeted improvements without bootstrapping a new runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Assess existing projects and apply approved improvements.
interface.longDescription: Inspect an existing local project, assess code and configuration against explicit requirements, then propose focused repairs or refinements. It changes only the user-approved paths and never scaffolds a new runtime.
defaultPrompt: Use Project Maintenance to inspect this existing local workspace, assess its implementation and configuration, and report prioritized improvements without changing files.
Use Project Maintenance to propose focused fixes for approved findings, but do not edit files or run commands until I approve the exact plan.
